# Pratim Narayan Moitra

> Pratim Narayan Moitra is a tourism social media marketer based in India. He runs social media, email and paid campaigns for tourism associations, DMCs, hotels and tourism boards. He has worked with PATA, ATTA, the World Food Travel Association and GBTA, and holds a Masters in Tourism Management from Amity University.

Short forms of the name: Pratim Narayan, Pratim N. Moitra. Contact: pratimxnarayan@gmail.com. LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/pratimnarayan.

## What he offers

- The free week. 5 finished social media posts with captions, delivered 7 days after a complete brief. The client keeps them whether or not they hire him. https://pratimnarayan.com/freeweek/
- The free audit. A written audit of website, social, email and search in 3 working days, with three priority fixes. No call needed. https://pratimnarayan.com/audit/
- The 90 Day Feed. Monthly social media management for tourism brands, end to end. Strategy, the content calendar, carousels and photo posters, Reels and short video, captions, posting, community replies and a one page report every month, with a growth target agreed in writing in week one. If the targets are missed at day 90, month four is free. https://pratimnarayan.com/services/social/
- Add on services. Video and Reels, email marketing, paid ads, website development and marketing coordination. https://pratimnarayan.com/services/video/ https://pratimnarayan.com/services/email/ https://pratimnarayan.com/services/ads/ https://pratimnarayan.com/services/websites/ https://pratimnarayan.com/services/coordination/
- Tiers. Social support, Social takeover and Full marketing. Plans are built around the client's budget.
- A 30 second intro film about his work is on the homepage and the about page. https://pratimnarayan.com/#film

## Who he works with

Tourism associations and trade bodies, DMCs and tour operators, boutique hotels and resorts, tourism boards, travel academies, travel media and booking platforms. He has worked with PATA, ATTA, GBTA, World Food Travel Association, Adventure.travel, and many more brands.

## Results

- One brand account grew from 13.02K to 23.68K followers across four platforms in under 90 days, up 82%. https://pratimnarayan.com/#results
- One Instagram account went from around 20 likes a post to over 200, with 502 likes on its best post. https://pratimnarayan.com/#results
- His promotion of the PATA summit lifted summit registrations by 25%. https://pratimnarayan.com/#results
- Across the tourism accounts he has run, 45% average rise in reach in the first 90 days, 30% more enquiries from social by month three, 1,700+ posts planned, designed and published, 2,500+ comments and messages answered for clients.

## Background

Masters in Tourism Management from Amity University and a BBA in Marketing. Interned at PATA as the only candidate selected from north India, with a personal endorsement from the CEO. First Indian intern at ATTA, with the role extended from 3 to 11 months. Currently Digital Systems and Marketing Consultant at the World Food Travel Association. Certified by ATTA and HubSpot Academy. Based in India.

## The What If episodes, newest first

- Episode 1. What if Belize posted like this? How a tourism board could announce a new route by showing the place, not the plane. The post got 104 likes on 157,000 followers. Style tested, epic scenery. https://pratimnarayan.com/whatif/belize/
- Episode 2. What if Aurora Expeditions posted like this? How an expedition operator could make its impact number the one people remember. The post got 21 likes on 54,000 followers. Style tested, documentary and wildlife. https://pratimnarayan.com/whatif/aurora/
- Episode 3. What if PARKROYAL posted like this? How a hotel group could sell a spa offer with the one view only it has. The post got 3 likes on 13,000 followers. Style tested, quiet luxury. https://pratimnarayan.com/whatif/parkroyal/
- Episode 4. What if GSTC posted like this? How the council that writes the standard could fill a free training day in Bangkok. The post got 5 likes on 5,900 followers. Style tested, photo poster. https://pratimnarayan.com/whatif/gstc/
- Episode 5. What if IBTM World posted like this? How a trade show could recruit buyers with the offer it already makes. The post got 5 likes on 16,000 followers. Style tested, text hook overlay. https://pratimnarayan.com/whatif/ibtm/
